about: Receipts for the facts Round 1312 added to src/data/usSeasonLedgerNhl.ts, read on 2026-10-12, each page drawn by script in a real browser (Chromium) and its own words read. A receipt of scripts/data/usSeasonSources1211.json is never repeated here: a page read again today is a new key in this file. Groups as in that file: the league's own site, its records site and its feed are one source (nhl); NBC Sports and NBC Chicago are one (nbc); Hockey Reference is one (sportsreference-hockey).

groups.nhl: The National Hockey League: its own site, its records site and its standings feed are one source, never two.
groups.nbc: NBC Sports and NBC Chicago are one source.
